prefetched_nodes.description: When nodes have been acquired by another process you can populate this field instead of "search_request".

search_request.description: The request that produces the nodes this block renders. The request curie determines the content type (search-articles-request, search-videos-request, etc) and its filters (category_refs, channel_ref, person_refs, timeline_ref, q, count, sort) determine the source.
